evidence.why: Hardcoded static salt shipped in source is the sole basis for the encryption key.
Key is derived deterministically from a hardcoded constant, not from OS keychain/Electron safeStorage, so anyone with the source/binary can decrypt credentials.json.
Credentials persisted to plain JSON file on disk encrypted with a recoverable hardcoded key, equivalent to cleartext storage at rest.

controls_present: AES-256-CBC encryption with random IV per write
other_classes_observed: No authentication/integrity check on decrypted data (no HMAC/AEAD)
